हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: A mysterious man working as a humble gun cleaner hides a dangerous secret—he is the legendary sniper Gun Master G9. When a ruthless colonel, deadly shooters, and a terror plot called Project Dancing Elephant threaten innocent lives and the nation, he must step out of the shadows. With unmatched precision and courage, the silent warrior returns to protect those he loves and stop a deadly conspiracy.
